verdict.rationale: Deepgram documents connecting voice agents to phone networks for outbound calls, and shows a per-call Twilio bridge. It documents no batch campaign management, dialing schedules, or throughput or concurrency controls. Individual outbound-call capability is adjacent to, not the same as, a scheduled batch campaign feature.

support.subject: As a founder, I can run batch outbound call campaigns with scheduling and throughput controls

citations.quote: Telephony: connect voice agents to phone networks for inbound and outbound calls.
